title: Whitebox sections missing implementation-critical subsections for wizard/filter features
description: Phase 3 is missing: Section 3.3 Alert/Workflow Tables (needed by SP-25/SP-26 for workflow_id/levels config), Section 4 PartyScopeFilter algorithm (needed by SP-14 for 5-step counterparty filter), Section 1.3 Bitmask-Based Scoping (needed by SP-17 for CommType bitmask), Section 3.6 RBAC Tables subset (needed by SP-28 for policy_visibility).
root_cause: Same root cause as lesson 3 — whitebox section selection uses coarse domain matching rather than feature-level requirement analysis. Wizard step features reference specific algorithms and table schemas that live in cross-cutting whitebox sections.
recommendation: Same fix as lesson 3: add a feature-level whitebox requirement scan. For each feature, parse its blackbox spec for references to specific data structures, algorithms, or table schemas, and include the corresponding whitebox subsections.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Whitebox Reference Sections
